telecommunications infrastructure is centralized, and virtually all infrastructure belongs to state-owned Telecom Egypt, whose ownership was placed under the Defense Ministry's National Service Projects Organization by a 2019 decree.","notes":["The excerpt does not use the broader term \"emergency circumstances\"; it specifies listed cases including disasters and national-security matters."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt's cybercrime law permits state authorities to block websites without a judicial order on vaguely defined national-security or economic grounds, imposes possible prison sentences and fines on service-provider personnel who do not respond swiftly, and leaves it unclear whether blocked websites can obtain an SCMR license or remain blocked after obtaining one.","notes":["The excerpt does not mention appeal prospects; it discusses licensing and continued blocking."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R02-E021","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A May 2023 Kaspersky report found that international hacking teams targeted Egyptian government institutions for espionage and data theft; the excerpt also describes cyberattacks, malware, and data-compromise threats affecting Egyptian users.","notes":["The excerpt does not characterize these threats as \"major.\""]}]}
